# wso2is_action (Resource)

Manages an action. An action is an HTTPS endpoint that you run, and that WSO2 Identity Server calls at a fixed point in a flow. For example, the server can call an action before it issues an access token or an ID token, so that the action can add or change claims. Other actions run before a password update, before a profile update, or before registration. By default, a tenant can have one action of each type. To import an action, use the ID `<type>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_action" "token_claims" {
  type                = "pre_issue_access_token"
  name                = "Add tenant claims"
  endpoint_uri        = "https://hooks.example.com/pre-issue-access-token"
  authentication_type = "API_KEY"
  authentication_properties = {
    header = "x-api-key"
    value  = var.hook_api_key
  }
  allowed_headers = ["x-request-id"]
  rules = [{
    expressions = [{ field = "grantType", operator = "equals", value = "client_credentials" }]
  }]
}

variable "hook_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication_type` (String) How the server signs in to the endpoint. The allowed values are `NONE`, `BASIC`, `BEARER` and `API_KEY`.
- `endpoint_uri` (String) HTTPS endpoint called by the server.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `type` (String) `pre_issue_access_token`, `pre_issue_id_token`, `pre_update_password`, `pre_update_profile` or `pre_registration` (the last needs to be enabled on the server). Changing it replaces the action.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the action is active. The default is `true`. The server creates actions as inactive, so the provider activates them after it creates them.
- `allowed_headers` (Set of String) Request headers forwarded to the endpoint (token actions only).
- `allowed_parameters` (Set of String) Request parameters forwarded to the endpoint (token actions only).
- `attributes` (Set of String) The claim URIs that trigger the action when they change. The server sends these claims to the action. Only `pre_update_profile` actions use this setting.
- `authentication_properties` (Map of String, Sensitive) The credentials for the endpoint. Use `username` and `password` for `BASIC`, `accessToken` for `BEARER`, or `header` and `value` for `API_KEY`. The server never returns these values, so the provider cannot notice changes made outside Terraform.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `password_sharing_certificate` (String) `pre_update_password` only: PEM certificate used to encrypt the shared password.
- `password_sharing_format` (String) How the server shares the new password with the action, either `PLAIN_TEXT` or `SHA256_HASHED`. Only `pre_update_password` actions use this setting.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules that decide when the action runs. The action runs when any rule matches. A rule matches when all of its expressions match. Without rules, the action always runs. Token actions can test the `application` (an application ID) and `grantType` fields. Password and profile actions can test the `flow` field, for example `adminInitiatedPasswordReset` or `userInitiatedPasswordUpdate`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Action ID.
- `version` (String) Action version.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `expressions` (Attributes List) Expressions, all of which must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--expressions))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--expressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.expressions`

Required:

- `field` (String) Field, for example `application`, `grantType` or `flow`.
- `operator` (String) `equals` or `notEquals`.
- `value` (String) Value to compare with.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_action.token_claims pre_issue_access_token/<action_id>
```
